recentItems.title: At least 5 dead after Amazon cargo plane barrels off Miami runway
recentItems.description:
An Amazon Prime Air cargo flight overran a runway and struck multiple vehicles on the ground while landing at Miami International Airport on Sunday, killing at least five people and injuring five others. Keith Mackey, an aviation safety consultant and former captain, breaks down how the investigation will likely proceed.

recentItems.title: At least 5 dead after Amazon plane barrels off Miami runway
recentItems.description:
An Amazon cargo plane barrelled off a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, killing at least five people as it struck vehicles and burst into flames, authorities said.


The Prime Air plane came to rest beside a roadway near two semi-trucks, according to images from the scene. The aircraft appeared to be resting on its belly and was largely intact despite the fire.

recentItems.title: Far-right AfD party takes big lead in German state election
recentItems.description:

It remains unclear whether the party will secure enough seats to form Germany's first far-right state government since the Second World War.

recentItems.title: AI-powered surveillance cameras are spreading in Canada
recentItems.description:
Automatic licence plate recognition cameras are in the spotlight as citizens across North America question their use by municipalities and law enforcement agencies — with some critics calling them a tool for ‘mass surveillance.’ 

One company in particular, Flock Safety, has found itself at the heart of the debate and while the company’s tech has yet to be used in Canada, greater awareness about these AI-powered cameras is raising questions about how Canadian ALPR camera makers operate.
